metadata.refinementNote: DEPENDENCY AND CORRECTION recorded before this expedition is started, by operator decision on 2026-10-13. This expedition is scoped to implement the decision matrix in docs/plans/testing-and-reporting-infrastructure-review.md, whose section 4.2 is titled 'Inventory (242 files, 114 in chain, 14 missing)'. That inventory is wrong and this expedition must not execute merges against it. Measured on branch arena/841cc45d-synth at f8bae1b, resolving test:all transitively (its command is a chain of `npm run test:X`, each resolving to a task in data/tasks/ whose own command runs the files; no unresolvable task ids): 242 test files exist, 127 are reachable from test:all, and 115 are NOT - 108 with no test:<name> script at all, plus 7 that have a script but are not in the chain (agent-sdk, ai-capability-projection, governance-orchestration, mcp-server, package-distribution, release, synth-cli-govern-explain). The doc accounts for 14 unaccounted files; the real number is 115, so it undercounts by 101. Executing all 107 scriptless orphans in a throwaway copy gave 36 red and 71 green with 0 timeouts, while the 42 reachable files swept as a control were all green - so the governed chain is not red today and the rot sits entirely outside it. The 71 green orphans carry 2190 assert call-sites and only one is a zero-assertion stub, so merging or retiring on the doc's list would destroy counted-nowhere coverage. SEQUENCING: EXP-TEST-005 'Every test file has an owner' (74c33996d5e7cf32, approved) runs FIRST and produces (a) a generated, re-runnable inventory artifact keyed on the task graph, (b) a file-level ownership guard, (c) a recorded disposition for each of the 115, and (d) corrected numbers in sections 4.2/4.3. This expedition then executes the merges against that generated inventory rather than the doc's hand-written lists. BOUNDARY: this expedition's promised guard - every test:* task in test:all or marked standalone - is TASK-level and cannot see the 108 files that have no task at all; the file-level guard belongs to EXP-TEST-005 and must not be duplicated here. USEFUL MEASURED INPUT for the merge clusters: 0 byte-identical files, but 37 files fall into 9 clusters with identical dist-import signatures - 11 importing only discovery/index.js, 6 only core/bootstrap.js (4 of them orphans), 4 discovery+environment, 4 execution/index.js, 3 runtime/replay.js (all 3 orphans), 3 mission-studio/index.js. Duplication here is overlapping module surface, not copy-paste, so cluster membership should be re-derived from the generated inventory's import signatures instead of the doc's name lists.
